description: This file defines the StepAdapter class, a custom PagerAdapter for managing and displaying steps in a showcase or tutorial within an Android application.

classes.name: StepAdapter
classes.description: A PagerAdapter subclass that manages the creation and binding of views for each step in a tutorial showcase, allowing button callback configuration.

methods.name: StepAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with context and list of steps.

methods.name: setButtonCallbacks
methods.description: Sets callback handlers for the finish, cancel, and next buttons.

methods.name: instantiateItem
methods.description: Creates and configures the view for the given step at specified position.

methods.name: destroyItem
methods.description: Removes the view for a given position.

methods.name: getStep
methods.description: Retrieves the step data at a specified index.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of steps.

methods.name: isViewFromObject
methods.description: Determines whether a view is associated with a specific key object.
